finding: CortexClearBuilding could generate a new visit nonce during resume when its separate context was absent/malformed/different. That can disassociate per-visit recovery history despite the durable order retaining its original lifetime.
implementation: Capture current visit context before room geometry. Resumes require its building/transform/hard-deadline prefix and nonempty string nonce. Unavailable context returns RESUME_CONTEXT_PENDING through existing discovery without operation admission, movement replay or a new nonce.
Original expired order retirement remains finite. Known moved-building pose mismatch cancels before context deferral or room geometry, rather than being retained as missing metadata.

Preparation commits require the captured context unchanged. Resumed job uses that captured context; only an explicit fresh clearance creates/publishes a nonce. No new callback, world query, transport, actor admission or deadline.
scopeBoundary: This is missing-context continuity, not a generic retry of settings/native ADOPT failures. ActorSettings ADOPT is strict metadata adoption; PENDING originates in other settings paths. Do not reinterpret every refusal as replication delay.

validation.development: Build1 caught an old regression that expected resume to mint a nonce for malformed context. It now requires fresh-only nonce creation. Build2/initial independent candidate passed, then final review moved existing transform cancellation before deferral. Build3 caught the old transform-guard test anchor; updated to assert cancellation before missing-context deferral and geometry.

limitations: Separate journals still lack coherent producer checkpoint/replay authentication and aggregate actor-ready/native-quiescence proof. Matching context is not proof that every other journal arrived.
Missing context may refuse until the original order expires; no fabricated fallback visit is supplied. Same-value newer task ambiguity remains without an ordered producer identity.
Normal/provider-HC replication order, physical task continuation, moved-building cancellation and5%median/10%p95 overhead remain unverified. Audits paused.
